body:
Workspace and dependency boundary. The workspace contains eight Go modules: the root plus contrib/debug, driver-mysql, driver-pgx, driver-sqlite, migrate, structbind and vet. Root packages use the standard library; external driver dependencies stay in contrib modules. go.work joins development checkouts, including its local replacement, so published module manifests need not point at local directories.

Evidence: ds:block?id=workspace-f7vpgvxp; ds:block?id=core-boundaries-y4kpz7kr. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
